nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Food security|Nutrition education and awareness_qna_000
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why is it important to combine strategies within each domain for encouraging sustainable food consumption?
nodes.answer: Simply providing information or making products affordable is not sufficient; combining strategies within each domain is crucial to effectively promote sustainable food consumption and overcome barriers to acceptance.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Food security|Nutrition education and awareness_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What was the main focus of the Healthy and Sustainable Diets Consumer Poll conducted by the Food Standards Agency (FSA, 2021)?
nodes.answer: The main focus of the poll was to gather insights into consumer perceptions and behaviours related to healthy and sustainable diets.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Food security|Nutrition education and awareness_qna_002
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What is the key aspect that actors in the food system must develop to enable consumers to make sustainable food choices?
nodes.answer: A common understanding of what constitutes a sustainable diet is crucial for actors in the food system to design and implement measures that enable consumers to make sustainable food choices.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Food security|Nutrition education and awareness_qna_003
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How were the most and least important food values guiding sustainable food choices in each country determined?
nodes.answer: The individual BWS evaluations (BW scores) were used to understand the food values guiding sustainable food choices in each country, followed by a cross-country segmentation based on the respondents' most preferred values.
